name: Spherification
summary: A liquid dropped into a calcium bath forms a thin skin of alginate gel; the sphere holds its shape on the spoon and bursts in the mouth.
how: Mix 0.5 per cent sodium alginate into the flavoured liquid and rest it until the bubbles go.
Drop the liquid with a spoon into a calcium bath of 1 per cent for 1 to 2 minutes.
Lift the sphere out and rinse it in clean water.
Serve within 5 minutes, because the gel keeps setting towards the centre.

origin.note: The elBulli kitchen made the alginate sphere a dish in 2003; the gel came from the food industry.

adoptions.via: The book Modernist Cuisine set out the recipes and the times, and Alinea served spheres on the tasting menu.
